decided: The concepts page's Consent section now says that apply or archive asks before writing unless the user typed the command or the user's chain setting granted it, and that bulk archive is never granted.
alternatives: leave the concepts page as it was, since the task list named only three other pages
point the concepts page at the customization page instead of restating the grant
why: Its old sentence said the workflow always asks when the AI arrives on its own, which a granted apply or archive no longer does; a page that states a false rule misleads more than one that says nothing.

defines.definition: the command that archives several changes in one go
